snippet.title: Groundwork - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Groundwork and play the free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5041330/Groundwork/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

Wiki: https://groundwork.peakd.wiki
Website: https://peakd.dev
X: https://x.com/Play_Groundwork
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/play-groundwork.bsky.social
